note: Every world allows player-made personas. BABEL's are the four from Halvorsen's, each starting where the tower put them on arrival night; a custom persona is another arrival from the same wave, landing on the Concourse. Stats are Prospero at creation (before any Tether or class); Grant's and Kenzie's are Vanta's sheets, Bri's and Chase's are drafts. Whoever is not the player stays in the world as an autonomous NPC (cast.json). Each persona's `knows` is what the player learns by choosing them; it stays hidden from the others.
